patch.value: Add --mention-map flag/PM_SLACK_MENTION_MAP env + dedup webhook-unset stderr notice

Adds per-command --mention-map flag and PM_SLACK_MENTION_MAP env for inline Slack mention resolution with layered precedence (PM_SLACK_ASSIGNEE_MAP < PM_SLACK_MENTION_MAP < --mention-map). Introduces formatMention() normalizing @handle and raw Uxxxx -> <@Uxxxx> while leaving <!subteam^...> untouched; buildMentionMap() merges sources (now pure: accepts env values as params). Suppresses repeated 'webhook not set' stderr via warnWebhookUnsetOnce() module-level guard (afterCommand hook fires every command). Fully additive/opt-in; default output unchanged. 40 tests pass.
